classification: independent host-only source review and temporary-file/mocked-process tests
approval_limit: No native qualification, Hoon compilation, live identity, merge, release, or deployment approval.

closing_disposition.scope: Synthetic raw transcript retention, runtime-log continuity/diagnostic detection, native-client framing and failure propagation. The complete core_test orchestration and actual runtime execution are separate gates.
verified_properties: Existing transcript files are not overwritten; line/total retention limits refuse and earlier complete evidence survives.
All-ship log reads retain exact deltas and use descriptor identity, full-prefix digest, bounded partial-line carry, and post-read pathname identity to reject uncertain continuity.
Signals/nonzero evaluator exits, silent missing output, malformed/partial frames and non-JSON constants cannot become a passing evaluator/control result.
Partial received frames, evaluator failures, timeouts and diagnostic prefixes remain attached to failed exchanges.
The 24 MiB raw-record budget retains the bounded failed-exchange representation; native wire limits remain unchanged.
limits: Runtime log diagnostics use a conservative pattern filter; zero matches are not proof of absence of every possible runtime fault.
Retained stdout/stderr prefixes are bounded. Temporary-file writes have no hard disk quota.
Host-written fixture files and mocked outputs test adapter behavior. No native evaluator, Hoon compiler, Gall observer or four-ship behavior was executed in this review.
The independent phase gate still requires exact current commit, source, loaded closure, Clay, toolchain, corpus and actual native evidence.
